Dear [Mr Bullock](/person/221),
I will try what I can do for Stephen Langton next week - if the Diocesan Synod leaves time.[^1]

I think it would be wiser to keep clear of Pope Pius V.[^2] There are a good many R Cs that I should much rather deal with

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Stephen Langton (c.1150-1228), archbishop of Canterbury. CMY was evidently proposing to write his biography for the series [\'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans\'](/book/358), intended for, but never published in, Bullock\'s Daily Lections.
[^2]: Pius V (1504-1572), pope from 1566, canonized in 1712. CMY may have objected to his excommunication of Elizabeth I or to his support for the Spanish Inquisition.

The phrase \'would be wiser\' suggests also that she remembered the Tractarians\' early public relations disasters precipitated by the publication of Romanizing books.
